steps.title: Open Codex
steps.body: Open the ChatGPT app and switch to Codex.

steps.title: Add a remote connection
steps.body:
1. Click Choose project above the prompt box.
  2. Name the project, open the Add a folder on this computer menu and select Add remote.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Create project dialog with Add remote

steps.title: Enter the details
steps.body:
1. Name the connection Eggie, select Identity, then copy the hostname, SSH port and identity file path from the card below.
  2. Click Save, and sign in with ChatGPT if asked.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Add SSH connection form, filled in

steps.title: Create a project
steps.body:
1. Create a new project.
  2. Enter the project's name.
  3. Select Eggie as the remote device.
  4. Select the projects folder and save.
  5. Click Trust folder if asked.
steps.alt: Video · creating a project on the Eggie remote

steps.title: Start prompting
steps.body: Describe your idea and let Codex build it.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Codex prompt in a project on Eggie

steps.title: Open Codex
steps.body: Open the Codex app and sign in.

steps.title: Run it in WSL
steps.body: In Codex's settings, choose to run the agent in WSL.

steps.title: Pick eggie-vm
steps.alt: Screenshot · WSL machine list with eggie-vm

steps.title: Start prompting
steps.body: Open the projects folder and say what you want. It cooks inside the kitchen.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Codex chat, connected to the kitchen
